en: Dependent on a state accompanied by rapture that is a root-cause, there arises a state not accompanied by rapture and not a root-cause, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition, twenty-eight; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition, twenty-eight.

Dependent on a state not accompanied by rapture and not a root-cause, there arises a state not accompanied by equanimity and not a root-cause, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition, eighteen; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition, eighteen.
